summary: The diagnosis has low confidence, so only general guidance is provided.

sections.title: General guidance
sections.body: Isolate the affected plant if possible and monitor for spreading symptoms over the next few days. Avoid applying treatment based on this result alone.

citations.title: General Leaf Disease Monitoring Practices
citations.snippet: When diagnosis is uncertain, growers are advised to monitor rather than treat prematurely.

safety_notice: Confidence in this result is low. This guidance is general and does not replace an expert diagnosis. No treatment dosages are provided.
